limitations: Seventy new-profile modes remain unsupported and six fail; old profiles retain their previous feature policies.
Iterator, regular-expression Symbol dispatch, species construction, spreadability, unscopables and disposal protocols remain incomplete.
Only Reflect.ownKeys is implemented. Global/host own-property reflection remains incomplete, including the global Symbol descriptor test.
Registry sharing between multiple realms is not implemented; current registry scope is one page Runtime/agent.
Legacy DOM/host Display conversions remain incomplete and can accept Symbols where Web IDL string conversion should reject them; their new description formatting cost is precharged.
Existing estimated work/storage budgets are not exact process accounting; existing four resource-stopped profiles remain observations.
No full web compatibility, production security, Vulkan integration or Chromium performance claim.
